ct-on-text.cab1.note: content type on a text piece

ct-overrun.cab1.note: content-type length past the record end

hash-mismatch.cab1.note: piece bytes whose sha256 is not the record hash

huge-length.cab1.note: record declaring 4 GiB - 1 bytes, past the cap

short-piece.cab1.note: piece record shorter than hash, kind and content-type length

trailing.cab1.note: one byte after the end record

unknown-type.cab1.note: record type 4 is not defined in v1

valid-at-cap.cab1.note: valid.cab1 with max_bytes exactly its length plus 128 bytes for each of its 9 records

valid-over-cap.cab1.note: valid.cab1 with max_bytes one below its length plus 128 bytes for each of its 9 records

valid.cab1.note: pieces of every kind (an attachment with a content type), exchange.begin and usage.attempt envelopes, one tombstone

zero-length-records.cab1.note: 1000 zero-length envelope records: about 5 KB of stream, past 64 KiB once each record is charged 128 bytes of decoded overhead
